name: Ziz Fizziks
objectiveText: Speak with Ziz Fizziks in Windshear Crag.

comments.body: At 58,62 myself. :-)
replies: Not knowing anything about this stuff, and picking up the quest in The Barrens, i assumed this was in The Barrens, its not. Stonetalen Mountains.
Ditto. Ended up South of the Hold getting slaughtered by Murlocs (God. I HATE Murlocs!)

comments.body: confirming 58,62
Windshear Crag is definitely in the Stonetalon Mountains. The coordinates for Ziz Fizziks are 59,63 in a little hut out in the middle of nowhere.

He's in a little green hut at 58 62

directly south west of the talondeep path.

when you enter the area you'll see spiders cross the river avoiding the goblins and human logger ect you'll see some trees and more spiders.

head towards the dotted line/path on the map.

he'll give you the next quest to kill operators

steps 3-5 of this quest are WRONG. The entire quest is obtainable at level 16 (at least).
This is good news to all the twinks out there.
This quest chain can be done by Alliance characters too.

For those of us who do not use Cosmos, as you enter Windshear Crag stay to the left. You will come to a very small house containing Ziz Fizziks. He gives you the next quest--obtaining blueprints for Super Reaper 6000.

Stay on the path, yes.  If you go to the river, you've massively overshot it.  On the map, the path with Y, the right-side, or NE-bound, path leads to Windshear.  The hut is just about equal to where the Winshear-bound path fetters out.

As a druid, I cat-form / prowled to the hut.

just go to that area and if you cant find it like i did just die

Take the road west from Ratchet all the way through the barrens and in to the Stonetalon Mountains.  Keep following it until the fork in the road and go right.  He is in a hut on the left.  Cords below are correct; 58,62

yeah I basically skimmed this quest and ended up on the other side of windshear crag XD a real pain in the ass seeing how there were mobs EVERYWHERE.  had to fight my way back after i found out he was right by the entrance.

Not to be confused with the gnome found at coords 59, 67.  Incedently if you go there first, you can then drop over the small cliff right to the guy's house without having to fight the spiders along the path.  However, you won't be able to climb back up. ha ha!
